data.title: 中野五月 · 上杉家餐桌的温馨晚餐
data.description: 温馨平实的日式矮桌旁，五月端着满满一碗冒着热气的白米饭，手握竹筷满足地夹起刚出锅的家常菜，融入家庭般的融洽笑意温暖动人。
data.action: sitting at dining table, holding rice bowl, chopsticks, heartwarming smile
data.promptProse: Sitting at a cozy, humble home dining table, Nakano Itsuki holds a ceramic rice bowl and chopsticks with a heartwarmingly content smile. The warm amber pendant light reflects off her star hairpins as steam rises from home-cooked dishes.
data.animaCaption: Holding a warm bowl of rice at the dinner table, she smiles fondly in the homey lamplight.
